name: mx-fluent
description: The Fluent language of @motifx-community/design-system, generated from the WinUI 3 theme resources (not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft): the shared primitives, its scales, its light and dark themes and its densities. Same token names as the default language (mx.resolver.json), different values. Design Tokens Resolver Module 2025.10.

primitive.description: Shared palette and scales, the same in every design language.

identity.description: Fluent corner radii (ControlCornerRadius, OverlayCornerRadius), elevation, type (Segoe UI Variable) and motion.

theme.description: Semantic colors and the focus ring, light and dark, from the WinUI theme dictionaries.

density.description: Control heights, paddings, gaps and the pressable feel.
